corrections.text: The article presents the May 13 opt-out and the October docs page as an unreconciled disagreement, says none of the cited pages explains the change, that the Herald "did not find" a communication of a timeline change, and that it "does not reconcile the two accounts". A Microsoft .NET Blog post of July 14, 2026 by the same author, "CoreCLR Progress and the Mono Timeline for .NET MAUI" (linked from the "Announcing .NET 11" post's MAUI section but not cited), says: "As of .NET 11 Preview 6, CoreCLR is the only runtime for .NET MAUI mobile apps" and "The previous build property to select Mono has been removed". The opt-out offered in May was therefore withdrawn in July, before the September 16 documentation commit and the October 13 docs page; that post does not give a reason beyond saying Microsoft had "accelerated our timeline".
